description_en: Creates a NAS file system and associates it with the office network of a shared cloud desktop
description_zh: 创建NAS文件系统并且绑定到共享型云电脑的办公网络
kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-and-bind-nas-file-system --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --file-system-name szy-asp-upm-test --storage-type Capacity --office-site-id 'cn-beijing+dir-15657*****' --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAndBindNasFileSystem

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the regions supported by WUYING Workspace
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the NAS file system
parameters.name: file_system_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the NAS file system
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The storage type of the NAS file system
parameters.help_zh: NAS文件系统的存储规格类型
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the file system uses Key Management Service (KMS) managed keys to encrypt data at rest. No decryption is required when reading or writing encrypted data.

When `FileSystemType` is set to `standard` or `extreme`, NAS-managed keys are supported. When `FileSystemType` is set to `extreme`, user-managed keys are supported
parameters.help_zh:
文件系统是否使用KMS服务托管密钥，对文件系统落盘数据进行加密存储。在读写加密数据时，无需解密。

当`FileSystemType`为`standard`或`extreme`时，支持NAS托管密钥；当`FileSystemType`为`extreme`时，支持用户管理密钥
parameters.name: encrypt_type

parameters.help_en: The user VHD capacity tier in GiB. Valid values: 5, 20, 50, 100, and 500. Default value: 500
parameters.help_zh: 用户VHD容量档位，单位GiB。支持5、20、50、100、500；不传默认500
parameters.name: size_quota

parameters.help_en: The ID of the office network
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the shared cloud desktop
parameters.name: desktop_group_id
